name: Oracle Glass Archer
loreTies: A sight-bound archer from Olympian oracle terraces who attacks through predicted angles instead of brute force.
Fires from elevation and rewards the player for closing lanes.
source culture humans later copied as Greek myth
shortBackstory: Oracle Glass Archer is a lore-faithful Olympian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Oracle Glass Archer belongs to The Celestial Heights of Olympus and exists to express Olympian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Fires from elevation and rewards the player for closing lanes.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Translucent oracle glass bow, white marble mask, gold laurel optics, sky-blue cloak. Abilities — Predicted Shot, Skyline Volley, Fate Thread Mark — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
